name: Solar radiation
description: How much sunlight the ground and the roofs receive in a typical year: direct sun past the buildings and dense trees, plus the light of the sky they see.

classify.title: Sunlight per year, kWh/m²
classify.note: PVGIS typical year: direct sun where lit, hourly on a mean day per month (Klein 1977), plus diffuse × sky view factor (Liu & Jordan 1960). Woods block (FAO forest: over 0.5 ha, trees over 5 m); single trees do not.
